Filed from /rebar-debug Phase 1 (analysis only). Phase 2 (repair) deliberately NOT entered at the operator's instruction — this ticket is the diagnosis work product; no code was changed.

Reproduction + experiment scripts (hermetic, temp git trackers, no writes to the shared store): /tmp/exp-signfence/exp.py (arms A/B — unrelated-churn isolation of the before!=after fence), exp2.py (arm C — isolates the under-lock locked_head!=expected_after clause), exp3.py (site C — 58.4% store-read-failure rate from another writer's locked add->commit staged-index gap). Investigation ran in worktree /Users/joeoakhart/debug-signreview-persist off origin/main; retired after the run.

Legitimacy: defect / incomplete implementation, cited against 790c-a7a3-120a-42c8 AC-1 (closed as met), the PlanReviewGeneration docstring at generation.py:30-46, and tests/unit/test_plan_review_generation_scope.py:1. caused_by attributed to d70a-d06e-aea0-4008 by scope-of-work, diverging deliberately from what git blame reports (5967-4476-7f9f-442d / 94e605a29d, which introduced the fence) — reasoning in the description under 'Defect origin'.

Nothing was written to the shared tracker during the investigation beyond this ticket and its two links.

comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body:
Investigation detail moved out of the description (plan-review oversize gate); the description keeps the problem, contract, fix direction, and ACs.

## Instrumented live run (site A)

Unrelated tickets named in every invalidating commit; subject `7931` never changed:

```
[20:55:27] before=aa28b30e   <- CLAIM_ENRICH 9263-b404-cb6c-463f
[20:55:32] after =f3a7dead   <- TICKET_DIGEST 9263  (attempt 1 invalidated)
[20:55:37] after =11d8f1d8   <- DONE_ENRICH  9263  (attempt 2 invalidated)
[20:55:42] after =f076f662   <- CLAIM_ENRICH 932d  (attempt 3 invalidated)
RESULT: remained unstable after 3 attempts
```

## Hermetic proof — single independent variable

Temp git tracker; `collect()` stubbed to return a generation IDENTICAL to `initial_generation`, so "the plan changed" is impossible by construction. Sole variable: whether an UNRELATED ticket commits during the attempt.

| arm | condition | result |
|---|---|---|
| A | unrelated ticket committing every 1s | `PlanReviewGenerationRetryable: plan review generation remained unstable after 3 attempts` (3x `before != after`) |
| B | tracker quiescent | `{"signed": True}` |
| C | HEAD stable across before/after; one unrelated commit lands only during lock acquisition | 3x `after='under-lock-mismatch'`, then exhausted — isolating the `locked_head != expected_after` clause, since `locked_generation is initial_generation` |

Site C (`store-read-failure`) confirmed separately: with a writer reproducing the locked `add`→`commit` gap, 87/149 (58.4%) unlocked `tracker_head_sha(..., ignore_untracked=True)` probes raised `store-read-failure` while the committed HEAD stayed perfectly readable.

## Churn measurement

Over the last 120 tracker commits the median inter-commit gap is 3s, and 65/120 are rebar's own background enrichment-queue events (`ENQUEUE_ENRICH`/`CLAIM_ENRICH`/`TICKET_DIGEST`/`DONE_ENRICH`), driven from the store write path itself (`_store/event_append.py::_maybe_enrich_drain`) and re-fed by `attest.sign_plan_review`'s post-sign `_enqueue_queue.enqueue` (attest.py:212-215). Measured `collect()` on an affected ticket: 3.3–3.7s (independently 4.3–5.8s under load), so the store-wide fence demands a ~5–7s globally quiescent tracker it structurally never gets. With MAX_GENERATION_ATTEMPTS = 3, no backoff on the head-fence branch, the whole retry budget burns inside one contiguous churn episode. ~25 `sign-review` rounds over ~20 minutes recovered none of the three affected tickets.

## Rivals killed

- "The plan/material drifted" — generation identical by construction in the hermetic arms; also `resign_plan_review`'s staleness guard passed, and 6 back-to-back `collect()` calls under live churn were byte-identical. That path raises `PlanReviewGenerationChanged`, a different exception.
- "Purely environmental contention" — arm B signs; and the churn is rebar's own unconditional background machinery.
- "Regression from 790c" — falsified: 790c's diff (`a4ff2801be`) does not touch `before`/`after`/`locked_head`.

## Why it shipped green

The regression test that encodes the scope invariant — tests/unit/test_plan_review_generation_scope.py ("Signing must survive UNRELATED concurrent tracker writes") — monkeypatches the fence out of existence at line 41: `monkeypatch.setattr(generation, "tracker_head_sha", lambda *a, **k: "b" * 40)`. With the store-wide quantity frozen to a constant, the test can never observe the fence firing, so it proves the d70a identity scoping while the two remaining store-wide comparisons stay untested.

## Defect origin (caused_by reasoning)

`git log -S'if before != after'` and `-S'locked_head != expected_after'` each return exactly one commit: `94e605a29d` (2026-07-22 11:32, rebar-ticket: 5967-4476-7f9f-442d, "Add phased plan-review attestations") — the commit that introduced the fence. Attributed instead to `d70a-d06e-aea0-4008` (`7c3c08df88`, same day, ~9h later, "d70a: scope plan-review signing to subject+related material, not the whole store"): d70a's scope of work was exactly this correction, its commit message diagnoses the class verbatim, fixes the identity comparison — and then states the omission outright: "The within-attempt before/after head fence is unchanged." Deliberate divergence from mechanical blame, recorded here.

Reproduction/experiment scripts were hermetic (temp git trackers, no writes to the shared store); investigation worktree /Users/joeoakhart/debug-signreview-persist, retired.

comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body:
Corroborating reproduction on epic 3d7a-7795-efde-4df7 (fresh /rebar-debug, 2026-08-22), cleanly isolating root-cause **A** (the `before != after` whole-tracker HEAD fence).

Read-only repro of the exact `before -> collect() -> after` triple + 3-attempt loop from generation.sign_manifest (NO signing, NO LLM), 12 trials against the live ~20-session store:
- collect() window for this epic: median 10.2s, max 12.9s, min 6.5s -- larger than the 3.3-5.8s in the RCA above because this subject is an epic with more plan-material pins (see the 3d57 link below).
- outcome: 9/12 would-sign, 3/12 EXHAUSTED all 3 attempts ("plan review generation remained unstable after 3 attempts") == a live ~25% sign-failure rate.
- reason histogram: {'head-move': 12} -- EVERY retry was mechanism A (before != after). Zero store-read-failure (mechanism C) and zero under-lock-mismatch in this window.

New causal link worth recording: the collect() window length is set by the SAME O(pins x4) full-store reduction as bug 3d57-602f-0b75-48ee (its confirmed RCA: current_material_fingerprint_impl -> live_material_children -> reduce_all_tickets, per pin). So the sign fence's required-quiescence window SCALES with 3d57, and 3d57's fix (one shared snapshot) shortens this window from ~10s to ~1s -- a strong partial mitigation for A, on top of the definitive fix this ticket proposes (fence against the subject's own generation, not store-wide HEAD).

Churn source (discriminating, re: any "isolate the enrich-drain" proposal): the HEAD moves are foreground `ticket: COMMENT`/`EDIT` writes from concurrent sessions -- sampled 6 moves/40s, ALL foreground; and 0 enrich-drain digest commits appeared in 21 collect() windows (the drain was blocked at 0% CPU during the sample). Isolating the drain in a dedicated clone would NOT fix this bug -- the churn is foreground.

For reference: the store-read-failure facet (mechanism C -> retryable) was fixed separately as bug ec1e-be67-8774-4eef (Gerrit 2118, merged). It converts C from terminal to retryable but does not address A, which this ticket still owns.

comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body: Fresh occurrence datum (2026-08-22, session closing lead-unpleasing-kitten): after a description edit staled the prior attestation, a fresh review-plan PASSed but sign_manifest failed with 'remained unstable after 3 attempts' on EVERY round across ~2.5h of retries — 8 sign-review invocations (24 fence attempts) plus the review's own inline sign all lost to mechanism A (before != after whole-tracker HEAD moves; retry log SHAs distinct each attempt). A spaced retry loop (45s between rounds) finally persisted the signature on round 6 (19:58 local). Consistent with the ~25%-per-round live failure rate recorded here; under busy-store periods the effective rate was 0% for over two hours.

1a2b59ea912d568fb9eed0c3adc1c8fdc6825d55 (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1,
0 unresolved comments).

Fix (per the d70a contract): the sign fence in
src/rebar/llm/plan_review/generation.py is scoped to the SUBJECT'S

- AC-7 stuck-ticket recovery, run with the FIXED build (head 1a2b59ea91)
  against the live busy store:
  * 111a-4626-8d2c-42bf — sign-review OK, signed=true, head_sha 1a2b59ea91.
  * 7931-faee-53ba-47b1 — sign-review OK, signed=true, head_sha 1a2b59ea91.

compiled_state.description:
# `sign-review` can never persist an attestation while ANY other ticket is being written: the sign fence compares store-wide tracker HEAD, not the subject's generation

## Symptom (reproduced, 2026-08-21/22)

`rebar sign-review <id>` — the documented no-LLM recovery for a plan review that PASSED but whose attestation failed to persist — itself fails, permanently, leaving the ticket unclaimable:

```
{"ok": false, "signed": false, "ticket_id": "111a-4626-8d2c-42bf", "verdict": "PASS",
 "reason": "the attestation could not be persisted: plan review generation remained unstable after 3 attempts"}
```

Affected: `111a-4626-8d2c-42bf`, `825c-ba3e-587b-4b7f`, `7931-faee-53ba-47b1` (each latest REVIEW_RESULT sidecar = PASS, 0 blocking; `review-plan --status` = `unsigned`). ~25 `sign-review` rounds over ~20 minutes recovered none. NOT bug `c083`: tracker `git status --porcelain` was EMPTY at reproduction time.

State of the code at writing: changes 2118 (`ec1e`, sign_manifest) and 2122 (`90c1`, resign's baseline collect) already made a `store-read-failure` from the pre-lock reads RETRIED within the loop and RETRYABLE (`PlanReviewGenerationRetryable`) on exhaustion. That fixed the failure's CLASS (terminal abort) but not its RATE: every retry re-gates on the same store-wide quantities below, so under normal churn all `MAX_GENERATION_ATTEMPTS = 3` attempts burn inside one contiguous episode and the caller-visible outcome is still "plan review generation remained unstable after 3 attempts", every time.

## Proven root cause

`generation.sign_manifest` validates signing against store-wide git state of the shared tracker rather than against the subject's own generation — the exact quantity `PlanReviewGeneration` deliberately excludes from identity. Three sites, one mechanism (line numbers at `origin/main` 4e2b4dfb3cf):

- **A.** `generation.py:316` — `if before != after:` (samples at :292/:294) compares whole-tracker `git rev-parse HEAD` across `collect()`. `collect()` takes 3.3–5.8s, so the fence demands a ~5–7s globally quiescent tracker; the store's median inter-commit gap is 3s, mostly rebar's own enrichment-queue events.
- **B.** `generation.py:359` — `under_lock_check`'s FIRST disjunct `locked_head != expected_after` compares a pre-lock HEAD sample against a post-lock one. Anti-correlated by construction: HEAD only moves via commits under this same lock, so whenever acquisition blocks, the wait ends precisely after a HEAD-moving commit. (Its SECOND disjunct, `locked_generation != initial_generation`, is the correctly-scoped check.)
- **C.** `relation_snapshot.py:140-152` — `tracker_head_sha` runs `git status --porcelain [--untracked-files=no]` WITHOUT the write lock and treats ANY output as fatal `store-read-failure`. The canonical writer does `git add` then `git commit` as two subprocesses under its lock (`_store/event_append.py`); an unlocked reader landing in that gap sees a STAGED (`A `) index-only entry — another writer's NORMAL footprint, not dirt. Measured 58.4% failure rate against a writer reproducing the gap. Post-2118/2122 this consumes the same shared 3-attempt budget as A instead of aborting terminally — same starvation, different exception class.

The advertised recovery is structurally unable to succeed under the concurrency AGENTS.md prescribes, and the classifier still names `recovery_tool="sign_review"`, closing the loop into a permanently unclaimable ticket. Hermetic single-variable proof (arms A/B/C), the instrumented live run, churn measurements, rivals killed, and why the regression suite missed it (the scope test freezes `tracker_head_sha` to a constant) are in the first comment.

## Contract violated (defect / incomplete implementation)

1. `PlanReviewGeneration` docstring (`generation.py:30-46`): `relation_snapshot`/`ticket_store_revision` are `compare=False` BECAUSE store-wide state made unrelated writes abort signing.
2. `generation.py:93-101`: "store-wide equality false-cancels on unrelated tickets' writes (bug d70a)".
3. `tests/unit/test_plan_review_generation_scope.py:1`: "Signing must survive UNRELATED concurrent tracker writes."
4. Bug `790c-a7a3-120a-42c8` (closed) AC-1: a PASS during which only UNRELATED store writes land ends certified with no manual step.
5. `sign_manifest`'s own docstring (`generation.py:270`): "Sign only if one stable generation still equals the immutable initial baseline" — it enforces store-wide HEAD stability instead, strictly stronger and unachievable under the concurrency AGENTS.md prescribes.

## Fix direction

Re-scope the fence to the subject's generation, which `collect()` already computes and which is deterministic under live churn. Concretely: DELETE the two store-wide HEAD comparisons — site A's `before != after` retry branch (and its now-unused `tracker_head_sha` samples) and site B's `locked_head != expected_after` disjunct — PROMOTING the under-lock re-collect comparison `locked_generation != initial_generation`, which already exists as `under_lock_check`'s second disjunct, to the sole authoritative pre-sign check (genuine subject/related drift stays fail-closed via the pre-lock `fresh != initial_generation` naming path and the under-lock re-check). For site C, `tracker_head_sha` must stop collapsing another writer's index-only staged entries (clean worktree column — that writer's normal locked `add`→`commit` footprint) to `store-read-failure`; worktree-side modifications, unmerged entries, and untracked files in strict mode stay fatal.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] `sign_manifest` signs successfully when only UNRELATED tickets commit to the shared tracker throughout the attempt — verified by a test that actually commits an unrelated ticket event inside the window, WITHOUT monkeypatching `tracker_head_sha` to a constant.
- [x] `sign_manifest` signs successfully when an unrelated commit lands during lock acquisition (the `under-lock-mismatch` path) — same no-freezing constraint.
- [x] A genuine change to the subject's own or direct related material still fails closed with `PlanReviewGenerationChanged` and names the changed component (unchanged behaviour; companion test).
- [x] `tracker_head_sha` no longer returns `store-read-failure` because another process has files staged inside its own locked `add`→`commit` window; a caller's genuinely dirty tracked worktree still fails (unit tests both ways).
- [x] `under_lock_check`'s mismatch is logged with a precise, distinguishable reason (generation drift), not a bare `after="under-lock-mismatch"` (25 field retries produced no actionable signal) — asserted via caplog.
- [x] `tests/unit/test_plan_review_generation_scope.py` no longer freezes `tracker_head_sha`, so the invariant in its title is actually exercised.
- [x] The three stuck tickets (`111a-4626-8d2c-42bf`, `825c-ba3e-587b-4b7f`, `7931-faee-53ba-47b1`) recover via `rebar sign-review` with no LLM re-run (run post-land against the shared store).

## Notes / out of scope

Aggravator, not root cause (own ticket if pursued): `tracker_head_sha` -> `ticket_reads.ensure_fresh` -> `_store_sync.reconverge` can itself MERGE `origin/tickets` and move HEAD from inside the fence window, and `under_lock_check` calls it while holding the write lock (re-entrancy).

file_impact.reason: re-scope the sign fence to the subject generation: remove the store-wide before/after HEAD comparison and the under-lock locked_head comparison; log under-lock generation drift distinguishably
tracker_head_sha: tolerate another writer's index-only staged entries (its locked add->commit gap); keep worktree-dirty/unmerged/untracked-strict fatal
stop freezing tracker_head_sha; add real-tracker tests committing unrelated events inside the window (AC-1/AC-2)
retarget store-read-failure stubs from tracker_head_sha to collect; replace head-instability tests with generation-drift under-lock tests
unit tests for staged-only tolerance and still-fatal dirty tracked worktree
docstring only: update the stale reference to generation.py's removed tracker_head_sha under-lock check to the under-lock re-collect (LLM-Review advisory on change 2142)
